description: List HTML templates and explorable archetypes from the public template catalog (https://github.com/VibeRooster/hatch-mcp/tree/main/templates). Returns `{ repo, browse, templates: [{ name, title, description, url }] }`. Descriptions come from each file's frontmatter. Open `url` for the HTML and hatch notes — this tool does not return the file body. Add a template by opening a pull request that adds `templates/<name>.md` on that repo. No arguments.
name: list_templates
title: List HTML templates
